title: Experiencing Low Water Pressure? Here’s Where to Look First
description: If your home suddenly loses water pressure, the cause depends on whether the problem affects one fixture or the entire house. A single weak faucet usually points to a clogged aerator or mineral buildup inside the fixture cartridge. If low pressure impacts every tap, check your main water shutoff valve to ensure it is fully open. Many homes also feature a pressure reducing valve near the main line; when internal diaphragms fail over time, household pressure drops significantly. If your shutoff valves are fully open and aerators are clean, contact a licensed plumber to safely test your incoming main supply pressure.
